overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains an active professional presence across niche social and professional platforms (LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon) with a combined follower base of 3,580. His posts focus on academic accomplishments, research findings, tool releases (CooRnet v2.0), and recruitment, yielding strong relative engagement from a highly targeted audience in academic and computational social science communities.

contentThemes.description: Sharing newly published papers, grants, and study findings on coordinated inauthentic behavior and information operations.
Updates on open-source tools developed by the research team, such as CooRnet v2.0.
Postdoctoral and PhD recruitment announcements for computational social science roles.
Promoting upcoming presentations and methodological discussions on disinformation research.

recommendations: Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn, as it holds the largest raw audience (1,850 followers) and generates high total interactions per post.
Leverage Bluesky's high amplification (reposts) by featuring direct links or visuals (charts, paper summaries) to expand reach beyond existing followers.
Cross-promote tool releases like CooRnet across all platforms simultaneously with tailored messaging for both technical and general academic audiences.
Encourage active community discussions by ending posts with open questions regarding methodology or policy implications.

platformInsights.bluesky: Yields the highest relative engagement rate (6.14% average ER) with a strong repost-to-like ratio, showing high audience willingness to amplify research papers and academic opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Provides steady baseline engagement among a specialized academic audience (aoir.social instance), with tool updates performing significantly better than general discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Drives the highest total interaction volume per post (average of 90 interactions per post), making it the most effective platform for grant announcements and hiring posts.
